source.title: G3 Basic Canonical Canvas Implementation Plan v0.2

trusted_statements.goal: Use the G2 SceneQuery contract to resolve candidates, visibility, and final order from FrameState inside Render Core rather than accepting a visible list from Demo or Shell.
produces: clip and effect dependency observations required by the direct path
forbidden: treating candidate query order as final render order
required_evidence: 100000 total records with approximately 500 visible and localized candidate traversal
camera-only invalidation without changing SemanticGeneration or RuntimeScene contents
zero total semantic object iteration in the normal render path
